parrafo.es: By Orly Massage Therapy es el estudio privado del terapeuta Orlando Castellanos en Brickell Key. Cada sesión de masaje relajante, terapéutico o prenatal se adapta a lo que tu cuerpo necesita ese día, en un espacio pensado para desconectar por completo.
parrafo.en: By Orly Massage Therapy is therapist Orlando Castellanos' private studio in Brickell Key. Every relaxation, therapeutic or prenatal session is built around what your body needs that day, in a space designed to help you fully disconnect.

hero.imagen_alt: Candlelit massage table with hot stones and oils at By Orly Massage Therapy, Brickell Key

parrafo_1.es: Orlando Castellanos dejó la seguridad de un empleo fijo en restaurantes para dedicarse por completo al masaje terapéutico. Se formó en Praxis Institute en Miami y hoy atiende cada sesión el mismo, sin turnos rotativos ni personal distinto cada vez.
parrafo_1.en: Orlando Castellanos left the security of a steady restaurant job to focus fully on therapeutic massage. He trained at Praxis Institute in Miami, and today he is the one working every single session himself, no rotating staff, no surprises.

parrafo_2.es: Cuida cada detalle de la experiencia (el ritmo de la sesión, la música, los aromas) para que salgas sintiéndote realmente atendida. Por eso la mayoría de sus clientes vuelven cada semana.
parrafo_2.en: He pays attention to every detail of the session, its rhythm, the music, the scents, so you leave feeling genuinely cared for. That is why most of his clients come back week after week.

texto.en: Relaxation, therapeutic, prenatal or lymphatic drainage massage, with candles, oils and music meant to help you switch off.

texto.en: You leave with less tension and a clear idea of when your next session should be.

texto.es: Un masaje de cuerpo completo para bajar el estrés y salir con la mente en blanco.

texto.es: Presión profunda enfocada en la tensión muscular acumulada y los puntos de dolor.
texto.en: Deep pressure focused on built-up muscle tension and pain points.

texto.en: A safe, adapted technique to ease the discomforts that come with pregnancy.

texto.es: Pensado para quienes entrenan seguido: mejora la movilidad y acelera la recuperación.
texto.en: Built for people who train regularly: improves mobility and speeds up recovery.

items.quote: I've been getting weekly massages with Orly, and they never disappoint. I recently started training again, and now more than ever I can truly appreciate how much these sessions help with my recovery, mobility, and overall well-being. Every massage leaves me feeling refreshed and ready for the week ahead. I'm already looking forward to next week's session. Highly recommend!
Espectacular, súper profesional. Aquí huele delicioso, la música es como de ángeles…. El trasmite una energía divina…. Lo recomiendo 100%

This was the perfect way to start my weekend. From the moment I walked in, I felt completely relaxed and cared for. Orly is incredibly talented, attentive, and creates such a peaceful experience. I left feeling lighter, refreshed, and with so much less tension. I can't recommend By Orly enough!
